74. I was not aware of these matters at the time, and Mr. Cheung did not inform me of the completion of the repair works, notwithstanding our prior agreement that he would notify me when the works were completed.

75. I further note that the completion dates of the repair works for the FS Water Tanks in Block G Wang Shing House (宏盛閣) and Block H Wang Chi House (宏志閣), as suggested in the minutes of meetings of the Incorporated Owners (Bundle H1-3 ISS EPP (6113-6115)), differ from those indicated in the witness statements of the workers from Red Sun and Tin Hung (Bundle C1-2 Police (1189-1192 & 1178-1183)). I had no knowledge of this discrepancy at the material time, and I am unable to say which, if either, of those accounts is correct.

PC&E Progress Reports  
76. I have reviewed the progress reports of PC&E, which are contained in Bundle M1 PC&E (896–1412). In those reports, I note an item described as “Water Tank Waterproofing”, which appears to refer to the FS Water Tanks repair works that Gordon had mentioned to me.

77. From pages 1220, 1231, 1239, 1247, 1255 and 1263, it appears that the FS Water Tank waterproofing works were to be carried out in two phases. Phase 1 involved Blocks F, G and H, while Phase 2 involved Blocks C, D and E. It is unclear from the documents when such works were to be carried out for Blocks A and B.
